{{Otheruses|Azure}}
'''Azure''' was the name of a pair of [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport]]s that escorted the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Lambda-class T-4a shuttle]] [[Oceana]] as it carried [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Kupalo]] on his transfer from the [[Defiance/Legends|''Defiance'']] to the [[Liberty/Legends|''Liberty'']].<ref name="Alliance">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''</ref>
